members.background: analytic number theory; zeta/L-functions, Liouville function, Mellin/explicit-formula arguments

members.background: quadratic Dirichlet characters, character sums, class-number formula

members.recommendation: Make good-prime selection under prescribed local Legendre conditions the next residual.
members.strongest_objection: Generic absolute character-sum magnitude estimates are not the target inequality; the target is sharp and one-sided relative to an arithmetic normalization.

members.finding: The exact finite-prefix imitation plus n^-2 tail is a valid same-domain transformation episode, unlike prior ambient path witnesses.
members.recommendation: Select SEARCH, not LIFT/JUMP; source preconditions are explicit.
members.strongest_objection: Prefix realization and positivity must be realized by the same q; separate witnesses cannot be glued.

members.background: counterexamples, hostile quantifier and constant checks

members.recommendation: Falsifier should attack tail constant, prefix-completeness quantifier, and same-q gluing.
members.strongest_objection: A finite list of q, or fixed-q positivity, cannot supply arbitrary prefix lengths.
